updates.title: GDP, second estimate (Q3)
updates.analysis: GDP came in at 4.3% against a 3.5% forecast, above expectations. The previous reading was 3.4%. The real GDP, annualized reading was the highest since Q3 2023.
updates.context: Headline U.S. GDP growth is annualized. Subsequent estimates add data and may revise the same quarter.

updates.title: Initial jobless claims (moved to Wednesday for Thanksgiving)
updates.analysis: Jobless claims came in at 189K against a 201K forecast, below expectations. The previous reading was 203K, revised to 202K. 4-week average 196K (previous 198K); Continuing claims 1.70M (previous 1.79M). The initial claims reading was the lowest since week to Jul 18.
updates.context: Initial claims count new unemployment insurance applications. The four-week average smooths weekly swings.

updates.title: PCE inflation · Personal income and outlays (Oct)
updates.analysis: Core PCE came in at 0.3% against a 0.3% forecast, in line with expectations. The previous reading was 0.3%. PCE m/m 0.3% (previous 0.5%); Core PCE y/y 3.3% (previous 3.1%); Personal spending m/m 0.3% (previous 0.6%).
updates.context: The Fed measures its inflation target using headline PCE. Core PCE helps identify the underlying trend.

otherCloses: At the Tue Nov 24 close, WTI crude $82.24 (up 1.0%).
